versions.changelog:
Initial release of the imesh skill.

- Provides commands to operate a local and networked IMesh node for peer discovery, skill invocation, and identity management.
- Supports asynchronous WebSocket communication, mDNS peer discovery, HMAC-signed tasks, and optional end-to-end encryption.
- Includes FastAPI gateway for HTTP and OpenAI-compatible API access.
- Documents recommended security and configuration practices.
- Adds troubleshooting section and coverage of common administration tasks.
